_sources: 26 USC 2010(c)(3) as amended by Pub. L. 119-21 sec. 70106 (basic exclusion amount $15,000,000 for 2026, indexed for inflation after 2026)
26 USC 2001(c) (top marginal rate 40 percent above $1,000,000 taxable; the unified credit offsets tax up to the basic exclusion, so each dollar above the exclusion is taxed at 40 percent)
26 USC 2010(c)(4) (deceased spousal unused exclusion, not indexed after the first death)
